obligations.expected_behavior: Static validation rejects a complex deterministic check whose declared working directory is unsafe.
forbidden_result: Accepting an unsafe declared cwd during static validation.
obligations.observable_result: The validator reports noncompliance when the check declaration contains an unsafe cwd.
obligations.state_after: The complex check declaration contains an explicit cwd that passes the safety boundary.
obligations.state_before: The declared cwd has not been validated as safe.
obligations.subject: Complex deterministic check working-directory validation
obligations.trigger: A complex deterministic check declaration is statically validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Static validation rejects a complex deterministic check invocation whose declared timeout is zero.
forbidden_result: Accepting a zero timeout in the check declaration.
obligations.observable_result: The validator reports noncompliance when the declared timeout is zero.
obligations.state_after: The check declaration has a positive bounded timeout.
obligations.state_before: The declared timeout has not been validated as positive and bounded.
obligations.subject: Complex deterministic check timeout validation
obligations.trigger: A complex deterministic check invocation is statically validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Create and use ADR-0062 for the repository Skill authoring contract without reusing or overwriting ADR-0060, which remains assigned to Skill-input selection.
forbidden_result: Reusing ADR-0060 for the new contract.
obligations.observable_result: The new contract is represented by ADR-0062 while ADR-0060 remains unchanged for Skill-input selection.
obligations.state_after: ADR-0060 retains its existing Skill-input selection role and ADR-0062 carries the new contract.
obligations.state_before: The relationship between the new contract ADR and existing ADR-0060 is not enforced.
obligations.subject: ADR-0060 preservation
obligations.trigger: The Package A contract ADR is authored or indexed.

forbidden_result: Using validator exit codes as a toolchain-wide error taxonomy.
